summary.text: Larry Bagley is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 7, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Caddo, De Soto, and Sabine parishes. First elected in 2015, Larry Bagley sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Appropriations, and Insurance committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Larry Bagley's occupation as owner of an Allstate Insurance agency, with a B.A. from Baptist Christian College, a master's degree from Stephen F. Austin State University, and 30 additional hours from Northwestern State University.

The House page lists Larry Bagley's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Appropriations, Insurance, and Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and North Louisiana Legislative Delegation.
